[[File:9laser-borer.jpg|thumb|250px|A laser-borer in use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orleon]].]]
'''Laser-borers''' were small treaded vehicles that seated a single operator. They were equipped with a single large laser that could cut through sheer rock. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] men used one to bore into the collapsed cave on [[Orleon]] where [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were trapped. Unfortunately for Jabba, [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]] got into the laser-borer and were thus brought aboard the ''[[Voidraker]]''.
